a01.title: Quintet Stack Ring
a01.descriptionHtml:
Five rings, worn as one. A plain silver tone band, two slim gold tone bands, a wide band of upright baguette cut cubic zirconia and a band of small round stones are stacked and held together by one polished gold tone loop, so the stack always sits in the same order. About 14mm tall on the finger.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone on the index or middle finger; it does the work of a full stack.

Details

  • Stack: Five bands linked by a gold tone loop, approximately 14mm tall
  • Bands: A plain silver tone band, two slim gold tone bands, a baguette channel band and a round-stone band
  • Stones: Baguette and round cut clear cubic zirconia
  • Size: Closed bands, sizes 6, 7 and 8 (to confirm with Albyluxe)
  • Metal: Gold tone and silver tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

a02.title: Heart Duet Open Ring
a02.descriptionHtml:
Two hearts, one of gold and one of light. A slim open band of polished gold tone ends in a puffed gold heart on one side and, on the other, a heart cut clear cubic zirconia in fine claws, or a round white shell pearl. The open back adjusts to fit US 5 to 9.

STYLING TIP: Wear it on the index finger with the two hearts turned towards you.

Details

  • Hearts: Puffed gold tone heart, approximately 7mm
  • Second motif: Heart cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 6mm, or a round shell pearl, approximately 6mm
  • Pearl: Shell pearl, provenance not stated by the supplier
  • Band: Slim open band, approximately 1.5mm
  • Size: Open, adjusts to fit US 5 to 9
  • Metal: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

STYLING TIP: Give the set; wear the earrings alone on the days after.

Details

  • Heart: Heart cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 8mm, in a pave halo
